name: dst-shift-notice
title: DST Shift Notice
description: Lists each attendee's affected dates with the new local time when daylight saving changes on different dates (US and EU weeks apart, India never), flags moves outside working hours, and offers to fix the series to the organiser's zone or UTC with a count of who moves.

meta.stops: Meeting moves an hour after daylight saving
meta.summary: Lists who sees a recurring meeting move by an hour when daylight saving changes on different dates, so part of the team doesn't miss it.
catches: Recurring meetings that shift by an hour for some attendees
Weeks where US and EU clock changes differ
New local times that fall outside working hours
How many people move under each anchor zone
limits: Uses the browser's time zone data (Intl), which can lag behind recent government changes
Attendee zones and working hours come from your props
a11y: Section labelled by its heading; zone choices are labelled radio options
Apply result is aria-live="polite"; failures use role="alert"
Icons are aria-hidden; times are written in text
